_note: Voice Eval Suite v1: 200 held-out short-form questions measuring the text-vs-audio delta ('voice tax'). Questions are original to this suite (written 2026-07, after all current model cutoffs; never copied from public benchmarks — TTS-rendered public evals are trivially trainable). Unlike SWE suites, items live in questions.jsonl rather than one directory per task: they are single-turn Q&A with no repo snapshot. Audio matrix: 3 voices (onyx/shimmer/fable) x rate (1.0/1.25x) x noise (clean / 10 dB SNR ambient). Full set runs on clean/normal per voice; a seeded subset (n=60, seed 20260729) runs the fast and noise conditions. Scoring is modality-blind: normalize -> exact/alias -> pinned LLM judge (RUBRIC.md). See docs/VOICE_EVAL.md.
decontamination_notes: All questions written for this suite in July 2026. Facts referenced are common knowledge, but phrasings and numbers are original; no item is drawn from any public benchmark or quiz dataset.
